sources.title: DeltaProduct/README.md at main · automl/DeltaProduct · GitHub
sources.snippet: DeltaProduct is a new linear recurrent neural network architecture that uses products of generalized Householder matrices as state-transition matrices enabling better expressivity, state-tracking, and language modeling performance than DeltaNet. - DeltaProduct/README.md at main · automl/DeltaProduct

sources.title: DeltaProduct: Improving State-Tracking in Linear RNNs via Householder ...
sources.snippet: Expressivity of Householder products. While any state transition matrix of DeltaNet can model a single Householder reflection (with β i = 2 $βi=2$), DeltaProduct's can model any orthogonal matrix.
